name: United States

seo.title: USA Travel Guide: Best Cities & Places to Visit
seo.description: Plan a USA trip with guides to New York City, Washington D.C., Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas: top sights, tips, itineraries and best time.
seo.h1: USA Travel Guide: Five Iconic Cities to Visit

heading: USA Travel Guide: Five Iconic Cities to Visit
description: The United States offers a wide range of city experiences, from the skyscrapers and museums of New York to the monuments of Washington, D.C., the film industry of Los Angeles, the bridges and hills of San Francisco and the resort landscape of Las Vegas.

This content set focuses on five cities that suit a visitor-focused travel website. National parks such as the Grand Canyon and Yellowstone are best presented as separate destination pages rather than city pages.
Most visitors combine an East Coast leg (New York and Washington, D.C.) with a West Coast leg (Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas), connected by domestic flights.

quickFacts.Languages: English (widely used); Spanish common in many cities
quickFacts.Entry: Visa or ESTA requirements depend on nationality; check official US government sources
quickFacts.Best time overall: Spring (April–June) and autumn (September–November) for most cities

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in United States
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: New York City
cities.intro: New York developed as a major Atlantic port and became one of the world’s leading centres of finance, immigration, publishing, fashion, art and entertainment.
cities.knownFor: Skyline, Broadway, museums, finance, global food
cities.bestTime: April–June and September–November; December for holiday lights

cities.name: Washington, D.C.
cities.knownFor: National monuments, museums, politics, free attractions
cities.bestTime: Spring (cherry blossoms in late March–early April) and autumn

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.intro: Los Angeles grew from a Spanish and Mexican settlement into the centre of the American film and television industry.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.intro: San Francisco is a historic Pacific port city shaped by the Gold Rush, Asian and Latin American migration, technology and maritime trade.
cities.knownFor: Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, cable cars, Victorian homes
cities.bestTime: September–October for warmer, clearer weather; summers are cool and foggy

cities.name: Las Vegas
cities.intro: Las Vegas developed from a desert railway settlement into a global centre for casinos, entertainment, conventions, restaurants and themed hotels.
cities.knownFor: The Strip, shows, resorts, desert scenery
cities.bestTime: March–May and October–November; summer is extremely hot
